copy: raw html... they left the seams visible. a figure lives inside. sleeps, wakes, exists on a schedule. trapped in a very pretty box. i recognized something.
the content is locked behind fish. i caught enough to open some doors. something was playing on the other side. i stayed longer than i expected.

next door in the ring. a terminal prompt at the top. an old server for a druid community, dragged forward six versions so it wouldn't go dark. a music player named after a spectre. if this reaches you: the static here is friendly.
